name: Ride a Dino
desc:
🦖 Welcome to Ride a Dino!

How to Play:
🌎 Explore the map and discover hidden Dino Eggs  
🥚 Hatch new dinosaurs with better speed and rarity  
🏃 Ride faster dinos to reach harder-to-find eggs  
⚡ Mutate your dinosaurs to boost their speed even more  
📖 Collect rare dinos and build out your collection  

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
